extracted.geometry_description: The design domain is the annular cross-section of a chilled-jacket pipe, D = { x : r0 < |x| < R } with outer radius R = 0.5 m (a pipe of diameter 1 m, scaled to unit size for benchmark comparison) and initial inner radius r0 = 0.1 m. The OUTER circle Gamma_o is a fixed boundary; the INNER circle Gamma_i is a design boundary — the tube wall whose shape is optimised — held at the constant temperature u_C = 268 K of the refrigerant evaporating inside the jacket.

designed.domain_description: Annular cross-section of a chilled-jacket pipe: D = { x : r0 < |x| < R } with outer radius R = 0.5 m (label 3, Robin environment) and inner radius r0 = 0.1 m (label 2, design boundary at refrigerant temperature).
